name: Seong of Baekje
contribution: The 26th king of Baekje, one of the Three Kingdoms of Korea, reigning from 523 to 554.

checks.lead: Seong (c. 504 – 554) was the 26th king of Baekje, one of the Three Kingdoms of Korea, reigning from 523 to 554. He was a son of Muryeong of Baekje and is best known for making Buddhism the state religion, moving the national capital to Sabi (present-day Buyeo County), and  reclaiming the center of the Korean Peninsula.
